title: According to Need wins duPont-Columbia Award

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: In December of 2020, 99% Invisible released a special miniseries called According to Need.
sentences.zh: 2020年12月，《99%隐形》发布了一个名为《按需分配》的特别迷你系列节目。

sentences.en: It was a riveting and revelatory exploration of the complex systems in place to help homeless people find housing in the Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 它对湾区帮助无家可归者寻找住房的复杂系统进行了引人入胜且发人深省的探索。

sentences.en: Former 99PI senior producer Katie Mingle spent two years reporting the story for us,
sentences.zh: 前《99%隐形》资深制作人凯蒂·明格尔为我们花了两年时间报道这个故事，

sentences.en: and a couple weeks ago we learned that the series received a DuPont Columbia Award honoring the best in journalism.
sentences.zh: 几周前我们得知，该系列节目获得了杜邦-哥伦比亚奖，以表彰其卓越的新闻报道。

sentences.en: In celebration, we are replaying the first couple stories from According to Need.
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝，我们将重播《按需分配》的前几个故事。

sentences.en: Plus, I'll catch up with Katie Mingle, who now works at a new podcast venture called...
sentences.zh: 此外，我还会采访凯蒂·明格尔，她现在在一家新的播客公司工作，名字叫……

sentences.en: What's my name right here?
sentences.zh: 我刚才叫什么名字来着？

sentences.en: Cereal?
sentences.zh: Cereal（谷物）？

sentences.en: Cereal.
sentences.zh: Cereal。

sentences.en: Never heard of it.
sentences.zh: 没听说过。

sentences.en: But first I want to start with congratulations, Katie, on winning the DuPont Columbia Award.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我想先祝贺你，凯蒂，获得了杜邦-哥伦比亚奖。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So exciting.
sentences.zh: 太令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: It's amazing.
sentences.zh: 真是太棒了。

sentences.en: What does it look like?
sentences.zh: 它长什么样？

sentences.en: It looks like a big, heavy baton that you could use to bludgeon a burglar.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像一根又大又重的警棍，你可以用它来痛打入室窃贼。

sentences.en: Um, it's silver.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它是银色的。

sentences.en: It's really heavy.
sentences.zh: 它真的很重。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's, yeah, it's a solid thing to hold.
sentences.zh: 它是，没错，拿在手里沉甸甸的。

sentences.en: So, well, in celebration of, According to Need, winning the DuPont Columbia Award,
sentences.zh: 那么，为了庆祝《按需分配》获得杜邦-哥伦比亚奖，

sentences.en: we're going to represent the prologue in the first episode,
sentences.zh: 我们将重现第一集中的序幕，

sentences.en: and then we should chat a little bit afterward to see if there's any updates on the rest of the series.
sentences.zh: 之后我们应该聊聊，看看该系列节目的后续有什么更新。

sentences.en: Great, yeah.
sentences.zh: 太好了，没问题。

sentences.en: I live in the north part of Oakland, near the border of Berkeley and Emeryville.
sentences.zh: 我住在奥克兰北部，靠近伯克利和埃默里维尔的边界。

sentences.en: Like other gentrifying places, this one was recently given a cutesy name by real estate agents hoping to attract new people to the area.
sentences.zh: 像其他正在中产阶级化的地区一样，这个地方最近被房地产经纪人起了一个可爱的名字，希望能吸引新居民。

sentences.en: Noby for North Oakland, Berkeley, Emeryville.
sentences.zh: Noby，取自北奥克兰（North Oakland）、伯克利（Berkeley）、埃默里维尔（Emeryville）。

sentences.en: I'm not sure the name is stuck, but the new people certainly have.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这个名字是否叫响了，但新居民确实已经住进来了。

sentences.en: They've moved into the 1920s bungalows and craftsmen's painting and landscaping and refurbishing the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他们搬进了20世纪20年代的平房和工匠风格住宅，粉刷墙壁、美化景观，翻新了整个社区。

sentences.en: My girlfriend and I moved to this neighborhood last year, and we were thrilled to find our apartment,
sentences.zh: 我和女朋友去年搬到了这个社区，我们很高兴找到了现在的公寓，

sentences.en: because it was two bedrooms with a nice big kitchen and a washer and dryer in the unit.
sentences.zh: 因为它有两间卧室，一个漂亮的大厨房，还有自带的洗衣机和烘干机。

sentences.en: My first ever.
sentences.zh: 我人生中第一次拥有这些。

sentences.en: All this and the rent was still under $3,000 a month, which, for the area, was actually extremely reasonable.
sentences.zh: 所有这些加起来，房租每月还不到3000美元，在这个地区，这其实非常合理。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Insane.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: But true.
sentences.zh: 但这是真的。

sentences.en: As we settled into the new place and started meeting neighbors,
sentences.zh: 当我们安顿下来并开始结识邻居时，

sentences.en: it didn't take long before we realized that some of them were homeless.
sentences.zh: 没过多久我们就意识到，他们中的一些人是无家可归者。

sentences.en: There was a guy sleeping in an old Lexus right in front of our house,
sentences.zh: 我们房子前面有一辆旧雷克萨斯，里面睡着一个人，

sentences.en: and another guy, who seemed to be living in the cabin of a boat,
sentences.zh: 还有另一个人，似乎住在一条船的船舱里，

sentences.en: parked on the side of the road, just across the street from us.
sentences.zh: 停在路边，就在我们街对面。

sentences.en: I was already working on this series about homelessness,
sentences.zh: 我当时已经在做这个关于无家可归者的系列节目了，

sentences.en: so, of course, I went to go say hi to the boat guy.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当然要去和那位“船民”打个招呼。

sentences.en: Knock, knock.
sentences.zh: 敲敲门。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Hey, how's it going?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm your neighbor.
sentences.zh: 我是你的邻居。

sentences.en: Oh, how you doing?
sentences.zh: 哦，你好吗？

sentences.en: Good, how are you?
sentences.zh: 很好，你呢？

sentences.en: I just took a bath, so right now I'm trying to get to work.
sentences.zh: 我刚洗完澡，现在正准备去上班。

sentences.en: I'm squinting up at my boat-dwelling neighbor, whose name is Michael.
sentences.zh: 我眯着眼看着我的“船民”邻居，他叫迈克尔。

sentences.en: The vessel he lives on is a 15-foot speedboat with a little sleeping cabin,
sentences.zh: 他住的船是一艘15英尺长的快艇，带有一个小小的睡眠舱，

sentences.en: and is named Grubba Dupa, or something like that.
sentences.zh: 名字叫“Grubba Dupa”，或者类似的名字。

sentences.en: Grubba Duba.
sentences.zh: Grubba Duba。

sentences.en: Grubba Dupa.
sentences.zh: Grubba Dupa。

sentences.en: Grubba Dupa, yeah.
sentences.zh: Grubba Dupa，没错。

sentences.en: Quick but important interjection here.
sentences.zh: 这里插一句简短但重要的话。

sentences.en: I found out later that Grubba Dupa means fat ass in Polish.
sentences.zh: 我后来发现，Grubba Dupa在波兰语里是“大屁股”的意思。

sentences.en: Who named it that?
sentences.zh: 是谁给它起的这个名字？

sentences.en: Yeah, my nephew.
sentences.zh: 哦，我侄子。

sentences.en: My nephew.
sentences.zh: 我侄子。

sentences.en: He just wanted a name out in the water.
sentences.zh: 他只是想在水上有一个名字。

sentences.en: They'd be on the CB.
sentences.zh: 他们以前会用无线电通话。

sentences.en: Grubba Dupa coming through.
sentences.zh: Grubba Dupa通过。

sentences.en: Grubba Dupa coming through.
sentences.zh: Grubba Dupa通过。

sentences.en: Michael is wearing jeans and an orange fluorescent vest and holding a hard hat.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔穿着牛仔裤和橙色荧光背心，手里拿着安全帽。

sentences.en: I find out later he's an electrician on a construction crew for a new high-rise in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我后来发现他是旧金山一处新高层建筑工地的电工。

sentences.en: So I live right over there, and I'm also a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 我住在就在那边，我也是一名记者。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: I've been doing a bunch of recording on people who are living in, like, RVs and cars,
sentences.zh: 我一直在录制关于住在房车和汽车里的人的节目，

sentences.en: and I haven't talked to anyone that's living in a boat.
sentences.zh: 但我还没采访过住在船上的人。

sentences.en: It's very fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太令人着迷了。

sentences.en: What I most want to know about Michael is where he's from, like, where he lived before he was homeless.
sentences.zh: 关于迈克尔，我最想知道的是他来自哪里，比如他在无家可归之前住在哪里。

sentences.en: There's this persistent myth about homelessness, maybe especially persistent in California,
sentences.zh: 关于无家可归，存在一个持续的迷思，也许在加州尤为严重，

sentences.en: that the homeless people here aren't really from here.
sentences.zh: 那就是这里的无家可归者并非真的来自这里。

sentences.en: Some people suggest that maybe folks came here from other areas to take advantage of better social services or better weather.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为，也许人们是从其他地区来到这里，以利用更好的社会服务或更好的天气。

sentences.en: But the data doesn't support this.
sentences.zh: 但数据并不支持这一点。

sentences.en: The last big survey done in Oakland found 78% of homeless respondents in the city of Oakland
sentences.zh: 在奥克兰进行的上一次大型调查发现，奥克兰市78%的无家可归受访者

sentences.en: reported living in this county, Alameda County, at the time they became homeless.
sentences.zh: 报告称他们在无家可归时就住在这个县，即阿拉米达县。

sentences.en: And most of the rest of the respondents just came from some other county in California.
sentences.zh: 而其余的大多数受访者只是来自加州的其他县。

sentences.en: I suspect Michael is from Oakland, maybe even from this neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑迈克尔是奥克兰人，甚至可能就是这个社区的人。

sentences.en: My mother, may you rest in peace, Mom.
sentences.zh: 我母亲，愿您安息，妈妈。

sentences.en: We used to stay right there.
sentences.zh: 我们以前就住在那儿。

sentences.en: Wait, where?
sentences.zh: 等等，哪里？

sentences.en: You're in that house right there?
sentences.zh: 你住在那个房子里？

sentences.en: I'm in the, like, beige tall one.
sentences.zh: 我住在那个米色的高房子里。

sentences.en: Yeah, that tall one?
sentences.zh: 是啊，那个高房子？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We used to stay there.
sentences.zh: 我们以前就住在那里。

sentences.en: You used to stay where I live?
sentences.zh: 你以前住在我现在住的地方？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Me and my mother and my younger brother.
sentences.zh: 我和我母亲，还有我弟弟。

sentences.en: In case you didn't catch that with the traffic noise,
sentences.zh: 如果你因为交通噪音没听清的话，

sentences.en: Michael is not only from this neighborhood, he used to live in my house.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔不仅来自这个社区，他以前还住在我现在的房子里。

sentences.en: He tells me later he hasn't lived in that house for many years, since the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 他后来告诉我，他已经很多年没住在那栋房子里了，从20世纪90年代开始。

sentences.en: And then he moved right next door, lived there for a bunch of years.
sentences.zh: 然后他搬到了隔壁，在那里住了好几年。

sentences.en: And then he left the neighborhood for a while, struggled with addiction, got clean.
sentences.zh: 后来他离开社区一段时间，与毒瘾作斗争，最终戒掉了。

sentences.en: And finally, he ended up back here, on the block he most considers home,
sentences.zh: 最后，他又回到了这里，回到了他最认为是家的地方，

sentences.en: and where he still has friends from the old days.
sentences.zh: 在那里他还有老朋友。

sentences.en: A lot of us, me and Toffrey, the one that sleeps in the Lexus.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人，我和托弗里，就是那个睡在雷克萨斯里的人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: His dad used to stay in one, two, three, four, about five houses down.
sentences.zh: 他爸爸以前住在一、二、三、四，大概五栋房子远的地方。

sentences.en: They had a trucking company called Toffrey Trucking.
sentences.zh: 他们有一家叫托弗里货运的公司。

sentences.en: Nice trucks.
sentences.zh: 很棒的卡车。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Of course, it makes perfect sense that most of Oakland's homeless population would be from Oakland.
sentences.zh: 当然，奥克兰的大多数无家可归者来自奥克兰，这完全说得通。

sentences.en: If you have even the most cursory awareness of what's happened to the housing market here in the last decade.
sentences.zh: 如果你对过去十年这里房地产市场发生的事情有哪怕最粗浅的了解的话。

sentences.en: Let's take the building I live in, where Michael used to live, as an example.
sentences.zh: 以我住的房子，也就是迈克尔曾经住过的地方为例。

sentences.en: It's a 2,200-square-foot duplex in North Oakland.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋位于北奥克兰的2200平方英尺的双拼别墅。

sentences.en: In 2009, the assessment records showed it was worth $105,000.
sentences.zh: 2009年，评估记录显示它价值10.5万美元。

sentences.en: Last year, it was assessed at a million dollars, and would probably sell for quite a bit more than that.
sentences.zh: 去年，它的估价是一百万美元，而且售价可能会更高。

sentences.en: In the last five years, especially, thousands of people like me have moved to the Bay Area for jobs,
sentences.zh: 尤其是在过去五年里，成千上万像我这样的人为了工作搬到了湾区，

sentences.en: and the cost of rent in places like Oakland and Berkeley has skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 奥克兰和伯克利等地的房租飞涨。

sentences.en: Low-income African-American residents in the area have been the hardest hit by all of this.
sentences.zh: 该地区的低收入非裔美国居民受到的打击最为严重。

sentences.en: As new people have arrived, thousands of Black people have moved away, and thousands have become homeless.
sentences.zh: 随着新人的到来，成千上万的黑人搬走了，成千上万的人变得无家可归。

sentences.en: My own neighborhood reflects this.
sentences.zh: 我自己的社区就反映了这一点。

sentences.en: Michael and I reflect this.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔和我反映了这一点。

sentences.en: But far beyond my block, you can see the effects of these economic and demographic shifts.
sentences.zh: 但远远超出我所在的街区，你可以看到这些经济和人口结构变化的影响。

sentences.en: Almost as if a tidal wave of wealth has washed the poor people of the Bay Area out of their houses and into the streets.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像一场财富的潮汐，把湾区的穷人从他们的房子里冲到了街上。

sentences.en: Like a lot of people, I probably looked past all of this for a while.
sentences.zh: 像许多人一样，我可能有一段时间忽视了这一切。

sentences.en: But eventually, just the sheer scale of it in my city became so startling that I started wanting to understand it and report on it.
sentences.zh: 但最终，我所在城市中这种现象的规模之大，让我感到震惊，我开始想要了解并报道它。

sentences.en: I didn't know what the story I wanted to tell was for a while, and it took me a bit to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间我不知道我想讲什么故事，我花了一些时间才弄明白。

sentences.en: Because there's this whole huge world you have to try to understand firSt.
sentences.zh: 因为首先有一个巨大的世界需要你去尝试理解。

sentences.en: And to start this series, I want to take you on a little tour of this world so that you can get a sense of it.
sentences.zh: 为了开启这个系列，我想带你参观一下这个世界，让你对它有所了解。

sentences.en: The most visible way that homeless people live in the Bay Area is the tent encampment.
sentences.zh: 在湾区，无家可归者最显眼的居住方式是帐篷营地。

sentences.en: Most of these encampments are easily seen from the road.
sentences.zh: 大多数营地从路上就能轻易看到。

sentences.en: In fact, they're practically in the road.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们几乎就在路上。

sentences.en: Tents and tarps and belongings spilling off of sidewalks and into streets.
sentences.zh: 帐篷、防水布和个人物品从人行道溢出到街道上。

sentences.en: But the encampment where Elizabeth Easton lives, in a tiny little house made out of plywood and two-by-fours,
sentences.zh: 但伊丽莎白·伊斯顿住的那个营地，在一个用胶合板和木条搭建的小房子里，

sentences.en: it was sort of hidden away, down a dirt path next to some railroad tracks.
sentences.zh: 它被隐藏起来了，在铁轨旁的一条土路下面。

sentences.en: Elizabeth told me she's always liked the idea of living in a tiny house.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白告诉我，她一直很喜欢住小房子的想法。

sentences.en: That's all I used to watch.
sentences.zh: 我以前只看那个。

sentences.en: What do you mean watch?
sentences.zh: 你指看什么？

sentences.en: Tiny house.
sentences.zh: 小房子。

sentences.en: On TV, yes.
sentences.zh: 在电视上，是的。

sentences.en: More than one.
sentences.zh: 不止一个。

sentences.en: Tiny house living, a tiny house nation.
sentences.zh: 《小房子生活》、《小房子国家》之类的。

sentences.en: She'd like to have a tiny house on some land that she's actually allowed to live on.
sentences.zh: 她想在某块她真正被允许居住的土地上拥有一间小房子。

sentences.en: But that's not what she has right now.
sentences.zh: 但那不是她现在拥有的。

sentences.en: Are you going to show me?
sentences.zh: 你要带我看看吗？

sentences.en: Elizabeth's house is dark and windowless.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白的房子又黑又没有窗户。

sentences.en: There's a futon that takes up most of the space.
sentences.zh: 有一个占据了大部分空间的沙发床。

sentences.en: And then piles of tools and clothes.
sentences.zh: 还有成堆的工具和衣服。

sentences.en: And then what's in that room?
sentences.zh: 那那个房间里是什么？

sentences.en: That's where I have my little toilet.
sentences.zh: 那是我的小厕所。

sentences.en: Elizabeth's bathroom is maybe two and a half square feet,
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白的浴室大概只有两平方英尺半。

sentences.en: with a dirt floor and one of those medical-looking toilet chairs with a bucket underneath.
sentences.zh: 铺着泥地，还有那种医疗用的带桶马桶椅。

sentences.en: Every few days, she empties the bucket and burns the waste.
sentences.zh: 每隔几天，她就会把桶倒空，把里面的秽物烧掉。

sentences.en: She also has a small front yard with a fence made out of pallets,
sentences.zh: 她还有一个用托盘木板围成的小前院，

sentences.en: where her two dogs can lounge in the sun.
sentences.zh: 她的两条狗可以在那里晒太阳。

sentences.en: It's a far cry from the places you see on Tiny House Nation.
sentences.zh: 这和你平时在《微型住宅国度》节目里看到的房子大相径庭。

sentences.en: But it's still home.
sentences.zh: 但这里依然是她的家。

sentences.en: I know one thing.
sentences.zh: 我明白一件事。

sentences.en: I'm not homeless.
sentences.zh: 我不是无家可归。

sentences.en: I'll put it that way.
sentences.zh: 我只能这么说。

sentences.en: They can say what they want to say, but I'm not homeless.
sentences.zh: 随他们怎么说，但我不是无家可归。

sentences.en: I have a home.
sentences.zh: 我有家。

sentences.en: Elizabeth preferred to think of herself not as homeless, but as homesteading.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白更愿意认为自己不是无家可归，而是在“安家”。

sentences.en: Homesteading is what she felt like she had done.
sentences.zh: 她觉得自己在做的事就是安家。

sentences.en: Found a little piece of land and claimed it as her own.
sentences.zh: 找到一小块地，并宣称那是属于自己的。

sentences.zh: 所以你明白是怎么回事了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I put my seat back.
sentences.zh: 是的，我把座椅放倒了。

sentences.en: I just had to record it right here for a moment.
sentences.zh: 我刚才必须得记录一下。

sentences.en: You got all the cover.
sentences.zh: 你把所有地方都遮好了。

sentences.en: Gotta wrap my feet double.
sentences.zh: 我得把脚裹两层。

sentences.en: So, my feet won't be cold because in the middle of the night, my feet be real cold.
sentences.zh: 这样我的脚就不会冷了，因为半夜的时候，我的脚会特别冷。

sentences.en: Talisha's in the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎坐在驾驶座上。

sentences.en: And our son, Jordan, is in shotgun.
sentences.zh: 我们的儿子乔丹坐在副驾驶。

sentences.en: She has a round face and a wide smile with a little gap between her front teeth.
sentences.zh: 她有一张圆脸，笑容灿烂，两颗门牙之间有一点缝隙。

sentences.en: She wears a beanie to keep her head warm.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一顶无檐小便帽来保暖。

sentences.en: And to cover the short hair, she hasn't had the money to get it done the way she likes it, with extensions.
sentences.zh: 也为了遮住短发，她没钱去做她喜欢的接发造型。

sentences.en: Jordan has his mom's same round face plus a round belly to match.
sentences.zh: 乔丹有着和他妈妈一样的圆脸，还有一个圆滚滚的肚子。

sentences.en: He's gentle and shy.
sentences.zh: 他性格温和又害羞。

sentences.en: He likes video games and math.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢电子游戏和数学。

sentences.en: And Talisha says she's thankful he isn't trying to act all grown like some kids his age.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎说她很庆幸他不像同龄的一些孩子那样装大人。

sentences.en: By the way, Jordan has a disability that affects his speech and language.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，乔丹有残疾，影响了他的言语和语言能力。

sentences.en: Wheels.
sentences.zh: 车轮。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Someone could drive.
sentences.zh: 有人可以开车。

sentences.en: You could drive and pull over and go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 你可以开车，然后靠边停车去睡觉。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That's what you want?
sentences.zh: 那是你想要的吗？

sentences.en: That's what you're thinking about?
sentences.zh: 那是你在想的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A nice one.
sentences.zh: 一辆不错的车。

sentences.en: A nice one, too, huh?
sentences.zh: 也是一辆不错的车，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, mommy liked to drive.
sentences.zh: 你知道，妈妈以前喜欢开车。

sentences.en: By 2019, Talisha and Jordan had been homeless for five years.
sentences.zh: 到2019年，塔莉莎和乔丹已经无家可归五年了。

sentences.en: Sometimes they stayed with family or friends, and sometimes they ended up in the car.
sentences.zh: 有时他们寄宿在亲戚或朋友家，有时则最终睡在车里。

sentences.en: For five years, they'd mostly just struggled through homelessness on their own.
sentences.zh: 五年来，他们大多只是独自在无家可归的状态中挣扎。

sentences.en: But then something changed, and they finally started trying to get some help.
sentences.zh: 但后来情况发生了变化，他们终于开始寻求帮助。

sentences.en: This is According to Need, Chapter 1.
sentences.zh: 这是《根据需求》（According to Need）第一章。

sentences.en: I want to zero in on the time when Talisha started asking for help so that we can see what
sentences.zh: 我想聚焦于塔莉莎开始寻求帮助的那段时间，这样我们就能看到

sentences.en: that looks like and start to see who the system works for and who it fails.
sentences.zh: 那是什么样子，并开始了解这个系统对谁有效，对谁又失效了。

sentences.en: But first, I want to go back.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我想回顾一下过去。

sentences.en: Should I get in with you or should we get in your car?
sentences.zh: 我是该上你的车，还是我们该进你的车里？

sentences.en: You want to get in my car?
sentences.zh: 你想进我的车吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Talisha told me about her life in a series of interviews we did in the car.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎在车里接受了一系列采访，向我讲述了她的生活。

sentences.en: She had never had it easy.
sentences.zh: 她的人生从来都不容易。

sentences.en: The stuff that I went through when I was little, it taught me my survival skills.
sentences.zh: 我小时候经历的那些事，教会了我生存技能。

sentences.en: Talisha's family was poor growing up.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎在贫困中长大。

sentences.en: Both of her parents struggled with addiction, and she had her first kid at 16.
sentences.zh: 她的父母都深受毒瘾困扰，她在16岁时就有了第一个孩子。

sentences.en: I didn't get a chance to enjoy my teenage years because I was a mom.
sentences.zh: 我没机会享受青春期，因为我早早当了妈妈。

sentences.en: There were so many obstacles and so much instability in Talisha's life.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎的生活中充满了障碍和动荡。

sentences.en: But somehow, by the time she was in her 30s, she'd managed to get her GED,
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，到了30多岁时，她还是设法拿到了高中同等学力证书（GED），

sentences.en: her forklifting license, and a good union job with benefits at Berkeley Farms Milk Plant.
sentences.zh: 考取了叉车驾照，并在伯克利农场牛奶厂（Berkeley Farms Milk Plant）找到了一份有福利的工会工作。

sentences.en: But then things started to unravel.
sentences.zh: 但随后一切开始瓦解。

sentences.en: It felt like there was one family crisis after another.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像家庭危机接二连三地发生。

sentences.en: I just went through a lot emotionally, and then my mom, she was sick and using drugs and
sentences.zh: 我在情感上经历了很多，然后我妈妈生病了，还在吸毒，

sentences.en: in and out of hospital, and it just got to the point where I was just, I was tired, Katie.
sentences.zh: 进进出出医院，最后我真的累了，凯蒂（Katie）。

sentences.en: Talisha started missing work at the plant.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎开始缺勤工厂的工作。

sentences.en: Eventually, she lost her job, and shortly thereafter, her apartment.
sentences.zh: 最终，她丢了工作，不久后也失去了公寓。

sentences.en: In 2014, she became homeless.
sentences.zh: 2014年，她变得无家可归。

sentences.en: For a while, she and Jordan found places to crash, and she worked temp jobs on and off.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，她和乔丹四处借宿，她也断断续续地做些临时工。

sentences.en: But they could only stay in one place for so long.
sentences.zh: 但他们在一个地方待不了太久。

sentences.en: You know, some people live different from how you used to live in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人的生活方式和你习惯的不一样。

sentences.en: Some people are dirty.
sentences.zh: 有些人很脏。

sentences.en: Some people are clean.
sentences.zh: 有些人很干净。

sentences.en: Some people get high, and you don't get high.
sentences.zh: 有些人会吸毒，而你不吸。

sentences.en: Somebody be like, you come over here for a few days, you give them some money, you eat and stuff,
sentences.zh: 有些人会说，你过来住几天吧，你给他们一点钱，一起吃点东西，

sentences.en: and then after that, they act funny or feel like they want their space and put you out.
sentences.zh: 然后过了一阵子，他们就开始变得古怪，或者觉得想要私人空间，就把你赶走。

sentences.en: They'd stay somewhere for a few months or a few weeks, and then it would be time to move on.
sentences.zh: 他们会在某个地方住上几个月或几周，然后就得继续流浪。

sentences.en: Years passed like this.
sentences.zh: 岁月就这样流逝。

sentences.en: Eventually, the instability started to wear on Talisha's mental health.
sentences.zh: 最终，这种动荡开始影响塔莉莎的心理健康。

sentences.en: Because being homeless mentally is trauma.
sentences.zh: 因为无家可归在心理上是一种创伤。

sentences.en: Especially when your child asks you, when you pick them up from school,
sentences.zh: 尤其是当你的孩子在放学接他时问你，

sentences.en: Mom, where are we going to go?
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我们要去哪儿？

sentences.en: Mom, where are we going to eat?
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我们要去哪儿吃饭？

sentences.en: Talisha felt like she was treading water, just barely staying afloat.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎感觉自己像是在踩水，勉强维持不沉下去。

sentences.en: Or maybe she wasn't staying afloat at all, but was actually slowly drowning.
sentences.zh: 或者说她根本没能维持住，而是在慢慢溺水。

sentences.en: She desperately needed a life raft.
sentences.zh: 她迫切需要一根救命稻草。

sentences.en: But there was no one stable enough in her life to grab onto.
sentences.zh: 但她生命中没有足够稳定的人可以依靠。

sentences.en: Everyone around her was also struggling.
sentences.zh: 她周围的每个人也都在挣扎。

sentences.en: I was to the point where I was really trying to figure out,
sentences.zh: 我当时真的在想，

sentences.en: where can I place and put my son that I can't provide for him the way I want to?
sentences.zh: 我能把儿子安置在哪里？我无法提供我想要给他的生活。

sentences.en: Like, let a family member have him for a while, you know, where he can eat, sleep, bathe, be clean, smoke-free environment.
sentences.zh: 比如，让某个家人照顾他一段时间，你知道，让他能吃饱、睡好、洗澡、保持干净、远离烟雾环境。

sentences.en: You know, stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，类似这样的事情。

sentences.en: And I could picture or figure out one person.
sentences.zh: 但我一个能指望的人都想不出来。

sentences.en: In 2018, after four years of bouncing around from place to place, Talisha suffered a psychotic break.
sentences.zh: 2018年，在四处漂泊了四年后，塔莉莎精神崩溃了。

sentences.en: For a couple of months, she had delusions that she was famous and wealthy,
sentences.zh: 有几个月，她产生幻觉，以为自己很有名、很有钱，

sentences.en: and she got aggressive when people tried to convince her otherwise.
sentences.zh: 当人们试图说服她事实并非如此时，她会变得很有攻击性。

sentences.en: When I start doing stuff I don't usually do, that's when I knew I needed help.
sentences.zh: 当我开始做一些平时不会做的事时，我就知道我需要帮助了。

sentences.en: During this time, while she was driving by herself, Talisha crashed her car, on purpose, into a wall.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，塔莉莎独自开车时，故意撞向了一堵墙。

sentences.en: She didn't want to die.
sentences.zh: 她并不想死。

sentences.en: It was more like a cry for help.
sentences.zh: 这更像是一种求救信号。

sentences.en: And I said to myself, if I hit that pole, I'm going to die.
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，如果我撞上那根电线杆，我会死的。

sentences.en: If I hit that brick wall, I can survive, but I'm going to be f***ed.
sentences.zh: 如果我撞上那堵砖墙，我能活下来，但我会完蛋的。

sentences.en: So I said, that's the pole, and I just turned the wheel.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，就是那根杆子，然后我就转动了方向盘。

sentences.en: After the crash, Talisha went to a regular hospital and then a psychiatric hospital,
sentences.zh: 车祸后，塔莉莎去了普通医院，然后又去了精神病院，

sentences.en: where she was diagnosed with PTSD, among other things.
sentences.zh: 在那里她被诊断出患有创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）等疾病。

sentences.en: And then, like she's always done, she clawed her way back to some fragile semblance of sanity.
sentences.zh: 然后，就像她一直做的那样，她挣扎着找回了一丝脆弱的理智。

sentences.en: And that brings us to 2019, when Talisha and Jordan, still homeless,
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了2019年，当时塔莉莎和乔丹仍然无家可归，

sentences.en: had exhausted every last family or friend connection.
sentences.zh: 已经耗尽了所有亲戚朋友的关系。

sentences.en: There was nowhere left to go, except for the car.
sentences.zh: 除了车里，已经无处可去了。

sentences.en: The car is sacred.
sentences.zh: 车是神圣的。

sentences.en: Talisha wears her keys on a lanyard around her neck.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎把钥匙挂在脖子上的挂绳上。

sentences.en: If it wasn't for the car, she tells me, they'd be living under a bridge.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，如果不是因为这辆车，他们就得住在桥底下了。

sentences.en: I just put my seat back, put my little thing to cover up the front window,
sentences.zh: 我只是把座椅放倒，放上我的小东西遮住前窗，

sentences.en: and we'll have our snacks and whatever else we eat, our cover, and we'll just go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我们吃点零食或其他什么东西，盖上被子，然后就睡觉。

sentences.en: Oh, my neck is killing me.
sentences.zh: 噢，我的脖子疼死了。

sentences.en: Your neck?
sentences.zh: 你的脖子？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: It's not killing me.
sentences.zh: 其实没疼死。

sentences.en: It's the way you're laying?
sentences.zh: 是因为你躺的姿势吗？

sentences.en: Oh, it's tight?
sentences.zh: 噢，是僵硬了吗？

sentences.en: Get in the back seat.
sentences.zh: 到后座去。

sentences.en: Maybe I get bad dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 也许我会做噩梦。

sentences.en: We can't go have no bad dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 我们不能做噩梦。

sentences.en: That's how the summer rolled forward.
sentences.zh: 夏天就这样过去了。

sentences.en: Stiff necks and backs, sleeping in the car, washing their faces at McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 脖子和背部僵硬，睡在车里，在麦当劳洗脸。

sentences.en: But then, when the school year starts, something kind of incredible happens.
sentences.zh: 但后来，当新学年开始时，发生了一件不可思议的事。

sentences.en: Talisha finally gets a life raft.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎终于得到了救命稻草。

sentences.en: Her name is Trish Anderson.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫翠西·安德森（Trish Anderson）。

sentences.en: Bless you, girl.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你，姑娘。

sentences.en: Keep it up.
sentences.zh: 继续加油。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Did you know, because I did not know, that every school district in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？因为我之前也不知道，美国每个学区

sentences.en: has a person
sentences.zh: 都有一名员工

sentences.en: whose job is to help homeless families?
sentences.zh: 专门负责帮助无家可归的家庭。

sentences.en: Trish Anderson is that person in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 翠西·安德森就是奥克兰负责这项工作的人。

sentences.en: Her title, the McKinney-Vento liaison, comes from the federal legislation that established
sentences.zh: 她的头衔是“麦金尼-文托法案联络员”，这个头衔源自确立

sentences.en: the position.
sentences.zh: 该职位的联邦立法。

sentences.en: Trish's office is in a little portable building behind an elementary school.
sentences.zh: 翠西的办公室位于小学后面的一栋小型活动板房里。

sentences.en: She has about a dozen bracelets on each wrist that clank on the table when she talks.
sentences.zh: 她每个手腕上都戴着十几条手链，说话时会在桌子上发出叮当声。

sentences.en: And she lets me interview her between emails and phone calls.
sentences.zh: 她在处理邮件和电话的间隙接受了我的采访。

sentences.en: Hi, Leslie.
sentences.zh: 嗨，莱斯利。

sentences.en: This is Trish.
sentences.zh: 我是翠西。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: So, Leslie, I have a situation.
sentences.zh: 是这样，莱斯利，我遇到个情况。

sentences.en: I have a mom and a daughter.
sentences.zh: 有一位母亲和她的女儿。

sentences.en: They're not in a car.
sentences.zh: 她们没车。

sentences.en: They have no place to go.
sentences.zh: 她们无处可去。

sentences.en: So, mom moved here from...
sentences.zh: 所以，这位母亲从……搬到了这里。

sentences.en: Over the course of the 2017-2018 school year, public school data shows that some one
sentences.zh: 在2017至2018学年期间，公立学校的数据显示，全国约有

sentences.en: and a half million students experienced homelessness across the country.
sentences.zh: 150万名学生经历过无家可归。

sentences.en: These students tend to move with their parents from one part of town to another to another.
sentences.zh: 这些学生往往会跟随父母在城镇的不同区域间辗转搬迁。

sentences.en: And a big part of the McKinney-Vento liaison's job is helping homeless parents enroll and
sentences.zh: 麦金尼-文托联络员工作的一大重点，就是帮助无家可归的父母为孩子办理入学

sentences.en: re-enroll their kids in school.
sentences.zh: 和转学手续。

sentences.en: Trish does a lot of that, but she can also help with things like bus passes and uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 翠西经常做这些事，但她也能提供公交卡和校服之类的帮助。

sentences.en: Sometimes they don't want what I offer.
sentences.zh: 有时他们并不想要我提供的帮助。

sentences.en: Like, I don't need transportation.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们会说我不需要交通工具。

sentences.en: I need a house.
sentences.zh: 我需要的是房子。

sentences.en: And I mean, that's real.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这很现实。

sentences.en: Trish can't offer housing per se.
sentences.zh: 翠西本身无法提供住房。

sentences.en: Although she can help parents fill out applications for apartments or search for affordable places
sentences.zh: 尽管她可以帮助家长填写公寓申请表，或者在网上

sentences.en: on the internet.
sentences.zh: 寻找经济适用房。

sentences.en: When a family in her program finally finds housing or shelter, they get a little construction
sentences.zh: 当她项目里的家庭最终找到住房或避难所时，他们会得到一个小小的手工纸房子

sentences.en: paper house to put on the wall.
sentences.zh: 贴在墙上。

sentences.en: So this one, someone went from car to shelter.
sentences.zh: 比如这个，有人从车里搬进了避难所。

sentences.en: So she decorated hers.
sentences.zh: 所以她装饰了自己的那个。

sentences.en: Any, any movement we acknowledge.
sentences.zh: 无论什么样的进展，我们都会予以认可。

sentences.en: Trish has a big, warm personality.
sentences.zh: 翠西性格开朗、热情。

sentences.en: But there's also something guarded underneath.
sentences.zh: 但她内心深处也有所防备。

sentences.en: When I ask her if she ever takes work home, she says she tries not to.
sentences.zh: 当我问她是否会把工作带回家时，她说她尽量不这样做。

sentences.en: She has her own problems at home.
sentences.zh: 她自己家里也有不少麻烦。

sentences.en: She's a caregiver for her son, who's schizophrenic, and for her elderly mother, who needs a lot
sentences.zh: 她要照顾患有精神分裂症的儿子，还要照顾年迈的母亲，后者在日常生活中

sentences.en: of help with day-to-day tasks.
sentences.zh: 需要大量帮助。

sentences.en: But every now and again, someone slips past her force field.
sentences.zh: 但偶尔，还是会有人突破她的心理防线。

sentences.en: Talisha was like that.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎就是这样。

sentences.en: Trish remembers seeing Talisha at the beginning of the school year, when she came to pick up
sentences.zh: 翠西记得学年初见到塔莉莎的情景，当时她是来为乔丹领取

sentences.en: a bus pass for Jordan.
sentences.zh: 一张公交卡。

sentences.en: She was slid down in a chair, had on a hat, looked very tired.
sentences.zh: 她瘫坐在椅子上，戴着帽子，看起来非常疲惫。

sentences.en: So I said, come here every day.
sentences.zh: 所以我对她说，每天都来这儿。

sentences.zh: 事实上，我真的开始每天都去了。

sentences.en: I have oatmeal, eat, get on a computer, look for resources.
sentences.zh: 吃燕麦片，吃饭，用电脑，寻找资源。

sentences.en: And while Talisha was there, Trish encouraged her to do something else, too.
sentences.zh: 在塔莉莎待在那儿的时候，翠西也鼓励她做点别的事。

sentences.en: Something she hadn't tried in a while.
sentences.zh: 一些她很久没尝试过的事。

sentences.en: Call 2-1-1 and ask for help.
sentences.zh: 拨打2-1-1寻求帮助。

sentences.en: 2-1-1 is a kind of hotline for homeless people who are looking for help with things like shelter
sentences.zh: 2-1-1是一条热线，专门为阿拉米达县那些寻求避难所

sentences.en: or housing in Alameda County.
sentences.zh: 或住房帮助的无家可归者提供服务。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for hoping.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您的致电。

sentences.en: How can I assist you today?
sentences.zh: 今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, me and my 11-year-old son is homeless.
sentences.zh: 是的，我和我11岁的儿子无家可归了。

sentences.zh: 您和儿子最近都睡在哪里？

sentences.zh: 昨晚您待在哪儿或者睡在哪儿？

sentences.zh: 在我那辆开不动的车里。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So tomorrow you can go at 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: 那么明天下午1点，您可以去

sentences.en: at the Henry Robinson Multiservice Center
sentences.zh: 亨利·罗宾逊多功能服务中心

sentences.zh: 进行CES项目的评估。

sentences.en: When the operator says the CES program,
sentences.zh: 当接线员提到CES项目时，

sentences.en: she's using an acronym for the Coordinated Entry System.
sentences.zh: 她指的是“协调准入系统”的缩写。

sentences.en: You're going to understand a lot more about this system by the end of this series.
sentences.zh: 在本系列节目结束时，你会对这个系统有更深入的了解。

sentences.en: But for now, I'll just say that most communities in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我只想说，美国大多数社区

sentences.en: have a system like this.
sentences.zh: 都有类似的系统。

sentences.en: And one thing it does is create a big master list of homeless people
sentences.zh: 它的作用之一就是建立一份庞大的无家可归者总名单，

sentences.en: that all the nonprofits in a particular community are working off of.
sentences.zh: 供特定社区内的所有非营利组织共同使用。

sentences.en: This helps to ensure that two different organizations
sentences.zh: 这有助于确保两个不同的组织

sentences.en: aren't trying to assist the same person without knowing it.
sentences.zh: 不会在不知情的情况下同时试图帮助同一个人。

sentences.en: Anyway, the operator is telling Talisha she needs to get into this system
sentences.zh: 总之，接线员告诉塔莉莎，她需要进入这个系统

sentences.en: in order to get help with housing.
sentences.zh: 才能获得住房方面的帮助。

sentences.en: And that, unfortunately, there are no shelters to stay in in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 而且不幸的是，在此期间没有避难所可以容身。

sentences.en: The next day, Talisha took the bus to the nonprofit in downtown Oakland that the operator had told her about.
sentences.zh: 第二天，塔莉莎乘公交车去了奥克兰市中心那家接线员提到的非营利组织。

sentences.en: While she waited, she eyed the other people who were also there.
sentences.zh: 等待时，她打量着周围同样在那里的人。

sentences.en: Everyone homeless.
sentences.zh: 每个人都无家可归。

sentences.en: Everyone in need.
sentences.zh: 每个人都需要帮助。

sentences.en: Eventually, it was Talisha's turn,
sentences.zh: 终于轮到塔莉莎了，

sentences.en: and she answered some questions with a social worker named Yolanda.
sentences.zh: 她回答了一位名叫尤兰达的社工提出的一些问题。

sentences.en: What is your monthly income?
sentences.zh: 您的月收入是多少？

sentences.en: Yolanda asked her.
sentences.zh: 尤兰达问她。

sentences.en: $836, Talisha answered.
sentences.zh: 836美元，塔莉莎回答。

sentences.en: Talisha didn't have a job at the time,
sentences.zh: 当时塔莉莎没有工作，

sentences.en: but she got some money from the state because of Jordan's disability.
sentences.zh: 但因为乔丹的残疾，她能从州政府领到一些钱。

sentences.en: Does anyone in your household suffer from depression?
sentences.zh: 您家里有人患有抑郁症吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In the past 30 days, have you had to do things that felt unsafe to survive?
sentences.zh: 在过去30天里，您是否为了生存而不得不做一些感到不安全的事情？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How often?
sentences.zh: 频率如何？

sentences.en: Daily.
sentences.zh: 每天。

sentences.en: There were more questions,
sentences.zh: 还有更多问题，

sentences.en: and Yolanda entered Talisha's answers into a computer while they talked.
sentences.zh: 尤兰达在交谈时将塔莉莎的回答输入了电脑。

sentences.en: The fact that they wanted to know so much about her seemed like a good sign to Talisha.
sentences.zh: 他们想了解她这么多情况，这对塔莉莎来说似乎是个好兆头。

sentences.en: She felt hopeful, even though they were still sleeping in the car.
sentences.zh: 她感到充满希望，尽管他们当时仍然睡在车里。

sentences.en: No, Mom.
sentences.zh: 不，妈妈。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: So what's your favorite food?
sentences.zh: 那你最喜欢吃什么？

sentences.en: Spaghetti's chicken and garlic bread with some salad, fish,
sentences.zh: 意大利面配鸡肉和大蒜面包，还有沙拉、鱼，

sentences.en: french fries and salad,
sentences.zh: 炸薯条和沙拉，

sentences.en: T-bone steak,
sentences.zh: T骨牛排，

sentences.en: potatoes.
sentences.zh: 土豆。

sentences.zh: 烤肉。

sentences.en: Mm-mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.zh: 烤肉。

sentences.en: Mm-mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I like zucchini.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢西葫芦。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What's your favorite dessert?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢什么甜点？

sentences.en: You like banana pudding?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢香蕉布丁吗？

sentences.en: No, I like chocolate.
sentences.zh: 不，我喜欢巧克力。

sentences.en: Chocolate cake.
sentences.zh: 巧克力蛋糕。

sentences.zh: 冰淇淋蛋糕。

sentences.zh: 冰淇淋蛋糕。

sentences.zh: 纸杯蛋糕和圣代。

sentences.zh: 圣代。

sentences.zh: 哦，我知道那是圣代。

sentences.en: You haven't had a sundae in the way out.
sentences.zh: 你很久没吃过圣代了。

sentences.en: While Talisha waited to hear back about whether she was going to get help with housing or shelter,
sentences.zh: 在等待住房或避难所援助消息的同时，塔莉莎一直去找翠西。

sentences.en: she kept going to see Trish.
sentences.zh: 塔莉莎的情况很有趣，因为你试图保持界限，但总有一两个，或者几个——我确实有几个——

sentences.en: It's interesting with Talisha because you try to have boundaries and there's always one or two or a few, and I have a few,
sentences.zh: 界限真的很难维持，因为他们有其他需求，或者他们会向你索取。

sentences.en: where the boundary is like it's really hard to keep that boundary because there's something else they need or they draw on you.
sentences.zh: 而她提出了要求。

sentences.en: And she demanded it.
sentences.zh: 她提出了要求，事情就发生了。

sentences.en: And she demanded it, and it happened.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样发生的，并不是每个人都会那样做。

sentences.en: It just happened that way, and not everybody does that.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，塔莉莎就开始叫翠西“大妈妈”，并告诉她自己爱她。

sentences.en: It wasn't that long before Talisha started calling Trish big mama and telling her she loved her.
sentences.zh: 她们俩在翠西的办公室里向我讲述了这件事。

sentences.en: The two of them recounted this to me in Trish's office.
sentences.zh: 就像，人们不会一进来就说“我爱你”。

sentences.en: Like, people don't come in and say, I love you.
sentences.zh: 你知道我在说什么吗？

sentences.en: You know what I'm saying?
sentences.zh: 然后我发现自己也回应了她，因为她需要这个。

sentences.en: And then I found myself saying it back because she needed it.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是她的要求。

sentences.en: So that was the demand.
sentences.zh: 她绝不接受任何少于此的回应。

sentences.en: She wasn't going to accept anything less.
sentences.zh: 我开始说是因为我想让她知道，你知道，我是真的爱她。

sentences.en: I started saying it because I wanted her to know, you know, I really, I do love her.
sentences.zh: 你情绪激动了。

sentences.en: You're getting emotional.
sentences.zh: 当然，我总是情绪激动。

sentences.en: Of course, I'm always getting emotional.
sentences.zh: 我是个感性的人。

sentences.en: I'm an emotional creature.
sentences.zh: 我也了解塔莉莎的这一面。

sentences.en: I know this side of Talisha, too.
sentences.zh: 我曾试图与她保持新闻工作者的界限，但她会突然发短信问我：“嘿，凯蒂，你在干嘛？”

sentences.en: I've tried to keep a journalistic boundary with her, but she'd text me out of the blue like, hey, Katie, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 或者她说：“我很伤心”，然后我就会发现自己在给她打气。

sentences.en: Or she'd say, I'm sad, and I'd find myself giving her a pep talk.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子是，不知为何，就在此时此刻，在翠西的办公室里，她和我挤在同一把椅子上。

sentences.en: Another case in point, for some reason, at this very moment in Trish's office, she was squeezed onto the same chair as me.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子是，不知为何，就在此时此刻，在翠西的办公室里，她和我挤在同一把椅子上。

sentences.en: I just squeezed on the chair with you.
sentences.zh: 我刚才和你挤在这张椅子上。

sentences.en: I know, there's this whole other chair right there.
sentences.zh: 我知道，旁边明明还有一张空椅子。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: See?
sentences.zh: 看到了吗？

sentences.en: See, Hashi?
sentences.zh: 看到了吗，Hashi？

sentences.en: I just don't demand me.
sentences.zh: 我只是不想强求自己。

sentences.en: You can't.
sentences.zh: 你做不到的。

sentences.en: You can't keep a boundary.
sentences.zh: 你无法守住界限。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 是啊，抱歉。

sentences.en: With Trish's support and a place to be every day, Talisha was finally in an emotional state where she felt like she could work again,
sentences.zh: 在Trish的支持和每天有个去处的情况下，Talisha终于调整好了心态，觉得自己可以重新工作了，

sentences.en: and Trish encouraged her to apply at a temp agency.
sentences.zh: Trish鼓励她去一家临时工中介申请工作。

sentences.en: She did, and she got a temporary position in washing dishes for Cirque du Soleil.
sentences.zh: 她照做了，并得到了一份为太阳马戏团洗碗的临时工作。

sentences.en: In the evenings, if Talisha had enough money, she'd buy herself and Jordan something to eat for dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚上，如果Talisha手头宽裕，她会给自己和Jordan买点晚餐。

sentences.en: Jordan would spread his homework out on the table at KFC or McDonald's.
sentences.zh: Jordan会把作业摊在肯德基或麦当劳的桌子上写。

sentences.en: Sometimes she'd even have enough money to do something fun, like a movie.
sentences.zh: 有时她甚至有足够的钱去做点开心的事，比如看场电影。

sentences.en: They were still sleeping in the car, but it felt like maybe things were turning around.
sentences.zh: 他们依然睡在车里，但感觉情况似乎正在好转。

sentences.en: I'm in the county, 2-1-Maja.
sentences.zh: 我在县里，我是2-1-Maja。

sentences.en: Can I help you?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: A couple weeks after that first call, Talisha tried 2-1-1 again.
sentences.zh: 在第一次通话几周后，Talisha再次尝试拨打2-1-1。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 您好吗？

sentences.en: Good thing I'm having you.
sentences.zh: 幸好有你接听。

sentences.en: Let me see if you guys have any rooms for rent on your listing or any transitional housing resource.
sentences.zh: 让我看看你们的名单里有没有出租的房间，或者任何过渡性住房资源。

sentences.en: Okay, just give me a second, please.
sentences.zh: 好的，请稍等一下。

sentences.en: Don't hang out.
sentences.zh: 别挂断。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And are you by yourself?
sentences.zh: 请问您是独自一人吗？

sentences.en: I have an 11-year-old son with a disability.
sentences.zh: 我有一个11岁的儿子，他有残疾。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The operator asked Talisha if she'd already done an assessment for the coordinated entry system, and she said she had.
sentences.zh: 接线员问Talisha是否已经完成了协调准入系统的评估，她说做过了。

sentences.en: Other than referring people into that system, where maybe, hopefully, they'll get assistance with housing,
sentences.zh: 除了将人们转介到那个系统——或许，希望他们能在那儿获得住房援助——

sentences.en: 2-1-1 also maintains their own database of subsidized housing options that you don't have to be homeless to get into, just poor.
sentences.zh: 2-1-1还维护着自己的补贴性住房数据库，不需要无家可归也能申请，只要贫困就行。

sentences.en: But all of those options have waiting lists.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些选择都有等待名单。

sentences.en: And the waiting list is from one to five years.
sentences.zh: 等待名单排期从一年到五年不等。

sentences.en: That's the problem.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: They can also give you a list of apartments on the private market that aren't subsidized,
sentences.zh: 他们也能提供一份私人市场上的公寓名单，虽然没有补贴，

sentences.en: but where the landlords might be willing to work with tenants that have less than sparkling rental histories.
sentences.zh: 但房东可能愿意接纳租房记录不太光彩的租客。

sentences.en: But there doesn't seem to be much of anything that would be affordable for Talisha.
sentences.zh: 但似乎没什么适合Talisha的经济适用房。

sentences.en: Okay, there is one.
sentences.zh: 好的，有一个。

sentences.en: Is this a room for rent in Oakland?
sentences.zh: 这是奥克兰的出租房间吗？

sentences.en: The price is $600 per person.
sentences.zh: 价格是每人600美元。

sentences.en: So you have to pay $1,200 for a room.
sentences.zh: 所以租一个房间要付1200美元。

sentences.en: You can tell the operator thinks $1,200 for a room is an absolute garbage option.
sentences.zh: 你可以听出接线员认为1200美元租个房间简直是个烂选择。

sentences.en: Too much, huh?
sentences.zh: 太贵了，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, for my own room, no, I'll try to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 我是说，为了拥有自己的房间，不，我会想办法的。

sentences.en: It is a little bit expensive, but all we need is our own room.
sentences.zh: 确实有点贵，但我们只需要一个属于自己的房间。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: Talisha told me later she didn't end up pursuing that room.
sentences.zh: Talisha后来告诉我，她最终没有去租那个房间。

sentences.en: It was too expensive.
sentences.zh: 太贵了。

sentences.en: Before they hang up, Talisha asks again about shelter.
sentences.zh: 在挂断电话前，Talisha再次询问了收容所的事。

sentences.en: The operator tells her that the only thing available is for victims of domestic violence and then asks her in a tone that can only be described as hopeful if she happens to be one.
sentences.zh: 接线员告诉她，目前唯一可用的名额是给家庭暴力受害者的，然后用一种只能形容为“充满期待”的语气问她，她是否恰好是受害者。

sentences.en: Yeah, unfortunately, are you a victim of domestic violence?
sentences.zh: 是的，不幸的是，您是家庭暴力的受害者吗？

sentences.en: In my past, but not recently.
sentences.zh: 过去是，但最近不是。

sentences.en: Yeah, unfortunately, there is nothing available right now.
sentences.zh: 是的，很遗憾，目前没有空位。

sentences.en: Trish told me she tells all of her homeless parents to call 2-1-1.
sentences.zh: Trish告诉我，她让所有无家可归的家长都拨打2-1-1。

sentences.en: But for most of them, it doesn't lead to housing, which she doesn't think is 2-1-1's fault.
sentences.zh: 但对大多数人来说，这并不能解决住房问题，她认为这并非2-1-1的错。

sentences.en: But it's still frustrating.
sentences.zh: 但依然令人沮丧。

sentences.en: Every time you call, you're getting the same interview over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 每次打电话，你都要一遍又一遍地重复同样的访谈。

sentences.en: And it's like they're collecting all this data, but there's no movement.
sentences.zh: 就像他们一直在收集数据，却没有任何进展。

sentences.en: What's a case that's really stuck with you, you know, without naming names, but like?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个案例让你印象深刻？不用说出名字，大概是什么样的？

sentences.en: The mom who says, if I don't find housing this year, I'm going to kill myself.
sentences.zh: 那位母亲说，如果今年我再找不到住处，我就自杀。

sentences.en: And my kids will be better off without me because at least they'll go into foster care and they'll get housed.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们没有我会过得更好，因为至少他们会被送进寄养家庭，能有地方住。

sentences.en: I had two attempted suicides last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我有两个自杀未遂的案例。

sentences.en: No, this year.
sentences.zh: 不，是今年。

sentences.en: I never saw that before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未见过这种情况。

sentences.en: So the mental health has really been on the decline for these families.
sentences.zh: 所以这些家庭的心理健康状况确实在恶化。

sentences.en: The stories Trish hears all day from these parents are hard.
sentences.zh: Trish整天从这些家长那里听到的故事都很沉重。

sentences.en: She tells me, while she bangs out a few emails, how she manages to hold so many sad stories.
sentences.zh: 她一边快速回复邮件，一边告诉我她是如何承受这么多悲伤故事的。

sentences.en: Well, my faith is what makes me have the most capacity to do the work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的信仰给了我最大的能力去从事这份工作。

sentences.en: I'm not a religious person, so I don't know what it feels like to have faith drive you like that.
sentences.zh: 我不是个有宗教信仰的人，所以我不知道那种信仰驱动的感觉是什么样的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, it's just a place to put it all so you're not carrying it.
